description: Brihat Jataka Ch. IX sl. 8 / Ch. VII sl. 6 worked example, printed p. 205 -- an independent source-published example, not produced by the calculator under test. Only each body's SIGN matters for Ashtakavarga; the longitudes below are chosen to reproduce the printed chart's sign groupings (Lagna and Venus share a sign; Mercury and Moon share a sign; the Sun, Jupiter, Mars and Saturn are each alone), verified against the printed per-sign dot/stroke counts, not a claim about the exact degree the source printed within each sign.
